name: Clover
description: Clover point of sale (Fiserv): merchant details and settings, inventory items with stock, categories, tax rates, discounts and modifiers, orders with line items, payments, refunds and tenders, customers, employees, roles and shifts. North America, Europe, Latin America or sandbox.
instructions:
## Clover
This connector uses the **Clover Platform REST API v3** for one merchant: business details and settings, inventory items with stock, categories, tax rates, discounts and modifier groups, orders with line items and discounts, payments, refunds and tenders, customers, employees, roles and shifts. It can create and update items, stock, categories, orders and customers. It does not take card payments or issue refunds: those happen on the Clover device or through the Ecommerce API.

**Setup (5 minutes)**
1. Sign in to the Clover Merchant Dashboard as an admin and open **Settings**, **View all settings**, **API tokens** (Account and setup, Business operations). Create a token and tick the permissions the tools need: Merchant read, Inventory read and write, Orders read and write, Payments read, Customers read and write, Employees read. For a test merchant, do the same from the Global Developer Dashboard (Test merchants, Launch dashboard).
2. Paste the token into `CLOVER_API_TOKEN`. It is sent as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.
3. Set `CLOVER_MERCHANT_ID` to the 13-character merchant id (mId), shown in the dashboard address `.../merchants/<mId>/...` and under Account and setup, Merchants.
4. Set `CLOVER_API_URL` to the region of the merchant: `https://api.clover.com` (North America), `https://api.eu.clover.com` (Europe), `https://api.la.clover.com` (Latin America) or `https://apisandbox.dev.clover.com` (sandbox).
5. Run `clover_get_merchant` to check the setup.

**Workflow**
- Merchant: `clover_get_merchant`, `clover_get_merchant_address`, `clover_get_merchant_properties` (currency, time zone), `clover_list_order_types`, `clover_list_roles`.
- Inventory: `clover_list_items`, `clover_get_item`, `clover_create_item`, `clover_update_item`; stock with `clover_list_item_stocks`, `clover_get_item_stock`, `clover_update_item_stock`; categories with `clover_list_categories`, `clover_get_category`, `clover_list_category_items`, `clover_create_category`, `clover_update_category`; `clover_list_tax_rates`, `clover_list_discounts`, `clover_list_modifier_groups`.
- Orders: `clover_list_orders` (filter by time, expand lineItems and payments), `clover_get_order`, `clover_list_order_line_items`, `clover_get_order_line_item`, `clover_list_order_discounts`. To build an order in one call use `clover_calculate_order` to show the total, then `clover_create_atomic_order`. Step by step: `clover_create_order`, `clover_add_line_item`, `clover_add_order_discount`, `clover_update_order`. `clover_void_line_item` and `clover_delete_order` remove lines and orders.
- Payments: `clover_list_payments`, `clover_get_payment`, `clover_list_order_payments`, `clover_list_employee_payments`; refunds with `clover_list_refunds`, `clover_get_refund`; payment methods with `clover_list_tenders`, `clover_get_tender`.
- Customers: `clover_list_customers` (expand emailAddresses and phoneNumbers), `clover_get_customer`, `clover_create_customer`, `clover_update_customer`, `clover_delete_customer`.
- Staff: `clover_list_employees`, `clover_get_employee`, `clover_list_shifts`, `clover_list_employee_shifts`.

**Switched off at install**: `clover_void_line_item`, `clover_delete_order` and `clover_delete_customer`; they cannot be undone, so an admin switches them on when the team needs them.

**Before writing**: orders and stock changes show up on the merchant's devices and reports at once. Clover updates records with POST to the record's address. `clover_update_item_stock` sets an absolute quantity, not a difference.

**Filters**: `filter` takes a list of conditions, each `field operator value`, e.g. `["createdTime>=1767225600000", "createdTime<1767830400000"]`; they are combined with AND. Time filters on orders, payments and refunds cover at most 90 days per request: split longer periods into 90-day windows. `expand` adds related records in the same call (comma-separated).

**Reading the answers**: lists come as `{elements: [...], href}`. Money is an integer in cents of the merchant currency (`1999` = 19.99); discounts are negative amounts. Quantities on line items (`unitQty`) are x 1000. Tax rates are x 100000 (`825000` = 8.25%). Times are Unix epoch milliseconds in UTC; convert with the time zone from `clover_get_merchant_properties`. Ids are 13-character strings.

**Paging**: `limit` (default 100, at most 1000) and `offset`. When a page has `limit` elements, ask again with `offset` + `limit`. Nested expanded lists stop at 100 entries.

**Limits and errors**: 16 requests per second and 5 concurrent requests per token (429 with `retry-after`). 401 means a wrong or revoked token or the wrong region in `CLOVER_API_URL`; 403 a token without the permission for that data; 404 a wrong merchant id or record id; 400 an invalid filter field.
prerequisites: A Clover merchant account (or a test merchant in the Global Developer Dashboard), an admin user who can create API tokens, and the merchant id.

CLOVER_API_TOKEN.label: API token
CLOVER_API_TOKEN.help: Clover Merchant Dashboard, Settings, API tokens: create a token with the permissions you need (Merchant, Inventory, Orders, Payments, Customers, Employees).
CLOVER_API_TOKEN.patternMessage: Paste only the API token, without spaces, quotes or a Bearer prefix.

CLOVER_MERCHANT_ID.label: Merchant ID
CLOVER_MERCHANT_ID.help: The 13-character merchant id (mId), visible in the dashboard address .../merchants/<mId>/... and under Account and setup.
CLOVER_MERCHANT_ID.patternMessage: Use the 13-character merchant id in capital letters and digits.

CLOVER_API_URL.label: Region
CLOVER_API_URL.help: https://api.clover.com (North America), https://api.eu.clover.com (Europe), https://api.la.clover.com (Latin America) or https://apisandbox.dev.clover.com (sandbox).
CLOVER_API_URL.patternMessage: Use https://api.clover.com, https://api.eu.clover.com, https://api.la.clover.com or https://apisandbox.dev.clover.com, without a trailing slash.

verifyHints.401: Clover refused the token. Check that it was copied whole, that it was not deleted in Settings, API tokens, and that CLOVER_API_URL is the region of the merchant (a sandbox token only works on apisandbox.dev.clover.com).
verifyHints.403: The token works but lacks a permission. Edit the API token in the Merchant Dashboard and tick the read permission for this data.
verifyHints.404: Clover found no merchant with this id. Check CLOVER_MERCHANT_ID (13 characters) and the region in CLOVER_API_URL.
verifyHints.429: Clover allows 16 requests per second per token. Wait a moment and try again.

tools.name: clover_get_merchant
tools.description: Get the merchant behind the token: business name, address, phone, website, owner and default currency. Expand employees or bank processing for more. Use it to check the token.

expand.description: Comma-separated related data to include: owner, address, properties, employees, tenders, openingHours, gateway, logos.

tools.description: Get merchant settings: default currency, time zone, locale, tips and tax settings, receipt and order options.

tools.description: List order types of the merchant (dine in, take out, delivery and custom ones) with label, taxable flag, fee and hours.

filter.description: Filters, each "field operator value", e.g. "modifiedTime>=1767225600000". Several filters are combined with AND. Operators: =, !=, >, >=, <, <=. Fields: id, deletedTime.

expand.description: Comma-separated related data to include: hours, attributes, categories.

offset.description: Records to skip, for the next page: offset + limit.

tools.description: List the employee roles of the merchant (admin, manager, employee and custom roles) with their system role and employees.

expand.description: Comma-separated related data to include: employees.

offset.description: Records to skip, for the next page: offset + limit.

Fields: name, sku, itemCode, price, hidden, available, modifiedTime, id, tags.id, tags.name, itemStock.quantity, itemGroup.id, deleted.

expand.description: Comma-separated related data to include: tags, categories, taxRates, modifierGroups, itemStock, options.

offset.description: Records to skip, for the next page: offset + limit.

tools.name: clover_get_item
tools.description: Get one inventory item by id with price, price type, SKU, code, cost and, when expanded, categories, tax rates, modifier groups and stock.

expand.description: Comma-separated related data to include: tags, categories, taxRates, modifierGroups, itemStock, options.

tools.name: clover_create_item
tools.description: Create an inventory item. price is in cents (1999 = 19.99) and required; priceType FIXED, VARIABLE (entered at sale) or PER_UNIT. Add categories with clover_update_item or in the body.

price.description: Price in cents of the merchant currency, e.g. 1999 for 19.99.

unitName.description: Unit for PER_UNIT items, e.g. kg.

alternateName.description: Alternate name, e.g. for kitchen tickets.

hidden.description: Hide the item on the register.

defaultTaxRates.description: Apply the default tax rates (default true).

isRevenue.description: Counts as revenue (false for gift cards or deposits).

colorCode.description: Button colour on the register, hex e.g. #FF0000.

tools.name: clover_update_item
tools.description: Update an inventory item (Clover updates with POST): name, price in cents, SKU, code, cost, visibility or categories. Stock is changed with clover_update_item_stock.

hidden.description: Hide the item on the register.

tools.name: clover_list_item_stocks
tools.description: List the stock of all inventory items: item id, quantity on hand (decimal) and the low-stock alert threshold.

offset.description: Records to skip, for the next page: offset + limit.

tools.name: clover_get_item_stock
tools.description: Get the stock of one inventory item: quantity on hand, stock alert threshold and when it last changed.

tools.name: clover_update_item_stock
tools.description: Set the stock of an inventory item to a new absolute quantity (not a change). Read the current stock first and confirm the new value with the user.

quantity.description: New quantity on hand, decimals allowed, e.g. 12 or 3.5.

stockAlertThreshold.description: Quantity at which the item counts as low stock.

tools.description: List item categories with name, sort order and colour; expand items to get the items in each category.

expand.description: Comma-separated related data to include: items.

offset.description: Records to skip, for the next page: offset + limit.

tools.description: Get one item category by id with name, sort order and colour; expand items to list its items.

expand.description: Comma-separated related data to include: items.

tools.description: List the items in one category with price, SKU and, when expanded, stock, tax rates and modifier groups.

expand.description: Comma-separated related data to include: categories, itemStock, options, tags, taxRates.

offset.description: Records to skip, for the next page: offset + limit.

tools.description: Rename a category or change its sort order or colour (Clover updates with POST). name is required by the API.

expand.description: Comma-separated related data to include: items.

offset.description: Records to skip, for the next page: offset + limit.

tools.description: List modifier groups (e.g. Toppings) with min and max selections and, when expanded, their modifiers with prices in cents.

tools.name: clover_get_order

tools.name: clover_create_atomic_order
tools.description: Create a complete order in one call from an order cart: line items (inventory items or ad hoc), modifiers, discounts and service charge, with totals and taxes calculated by Clover.

orderCart.description: The cart: {currency?, title?, note?, orderType?: {id}, lineItems: [{item?: {id}, name?, price?, unitQty?, note?, modifications?: [{modifier: {id}}], discounts?: [{name, percentage|amount}]}], discounts?: [{name, percentage|amount}], serviceCharge?: {id}}. Prices in cents; unitQty is quantity x 1000.

tools.name: clover_calculate_order
tools.description: Calculate an order cart without saving it: totals, taxes, discounts and service charges for the same cart as clover_create_atomic_order. Use it to quote a total.

orderCart.description: The cart, same shape as for clover_create_atomic_order.

tools.name: clover_create_order
tools.description: Create an empty custom order (title, note, state, order type), then add lines with clover_add_line_item. For a full order in one call use clover_create_atomic_order.

title.description: Order title, e.g. table or pickup name.

tools.name: clover_update_order
tools.description: Update an order (Clover updates with POST): title, note, state, order type or tax removal. Lines are changed with the line item tools.

state.description: Order state, e.g. open or locked.

tools.name: clover_list_order_line_items

expand.description: Comma-separated related data to include: discounts, modifications, taxRates, payments.

tools.name: clover_get_order_line_item

tools.name: clover_add_line_item
tools.description: Add a line item to an order: an inventory item by id, or an ad hoc line with name and price in cents. unitQty is quantity x 1000 for per-unit items.

name.description: Name of an ad hoc line.

price.description: Price in cents (for an ad hoc line or to override).

unitQty.description: Quantity x 1000 for PER_UNIT items, e.g. 1500 for 1.5 kg.

printed.description: Already sent to the kitchen printer.

tools.name: clover_void_line_item
tools.description: Remove (void) a line item from an order. Voided lines stay in reports as voids and cannot be restored, so confirm with the user first.

amount.description: Amount off in cents, negative, e.g. -500 for 5.00 off.

tools.name: clover_delete_order
